## Summary

Describe the user-facing or maintenance change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Keyboard and focus behavior checked when UI changed
- [ ] Reset/destroy restores the host page
- [ ] Documentation and notices updated when applicable
- [ ] No credential, private endpoint, customer data, or definitive WCAG claim added

## Accessibility impact

Describe what was manually tested, including browser and assistive technology where applicable. Do not infer site-wide WCAG conformance from the widget.
